name: Hacker News comment — miniature painting tips
text: Sublime work OP. Love the sheen control, the glossy coffee. Since they're clearly a warhammer 40k fan, a recent discovery of mine for mini painting: artist gouache or artist watercolor are awesome for pin-lining and recess shading the way oil paint or enamels are often used for those tasks, but only water is needed instead of white spirit. And they're indefinitely "editable" with a damp brush / qtip. The only downside is that you need to varnish to seal the watercolor before painting over it. A black and a burnt umber alone will get you really far. Make sure the gouache or watercolor use a gum arabic binder.

page.title: Damn fine tiny cafe | Hacker News

text: Whats really sad for aviation is there was already an extensive network of ground based navaids. As GPS has proliferated, they've slowly been decommissioned as they age out to save on cost. I'm specifically referring to VORs which provide azimuth and range to station.

name: News article — Nepal and China flood death toll
text: The death toll from catastrophic flooding in Nepal and China has reached 1,019, and more than 4,400 people remain missing as rescue crews work to reach communities cut off by the disaster. In an update on Tuesday, Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) revised the number of deaths to 1,003 from 987, with 3,916 people missing, including 583 foreigners.

page.title: Death toll from devastating floods in Nepal and China surpasses 1,000 | Al Jazeera

name: News article — Messi's international career record
text: Argentina superstar Lionel Messi, one of the greatest footballers of all time, brought down the curtain on his two-decade-long international career on Monday. The 39-year-old diminutive forward broke several records, won trophies and registered numerous goals and assists during his time with Argentina. Messi won the FIFA World Cup once, in Qatar in 2022, leading Argentina to their first world title since 1986. He also reached the final two other times, in 2014 and 2026, losing to Germany and Spain, respectively.

page.title: Lionel Messi's Argentina career in numbers: Records, goals, trophies | Al Jazeera

name: News article — Apple's new CEO takes over
text: John Ternus becomes Apple's chief executive on Tuesday, taking over from Tim Cook after a 15-year tenure. Ternus inherits a company that dominates the smartphone market but lags competitors in artificial intelligence capabilities. Ternus, 51, joined Apple's design team in 2001 and rose to senior vice president of hardware engineering. He oversees the engineering teams responsible for Apple's entire product lineup, particularly iPhones, which generate most company revenue. The transition occurs just one week before Apple's annual iPhone event on September 9, where the company is expected to introduce its first foldable handset.

page.title: John Ternus to lead Apple into the age of AI | Al Jazeera
